WM_preceding_scope.text: \paragraph{Standing torus-fibration setting.} The ambient space is a smooth compact complex threefold $Y$ with $b_1(Y)=b_2(Y)=0$, and $f:Y\to B$ is proper and surjective with connected fibres and smooth general fibre a complex two-torus. Every statement below concerning an irreducible support uses its actual full fibre $mS$, normalization and resolution. The global assertions expressly retaining the hypothesis that every support is irreducible or has normal crossings are used with that hypothesis. Constructions and comparison examples with different Betti numbers state their own assumptions.
